# A diagnostic over perl 5.42's lib that perl itself warns or dies on, and so
# is admitted beyond lib_baseline.txt: the privlib-relative diagnostic, a tab,
# and the line perl -w prints for that file, or for a minimal file with the
# same construct, copied verbatim.
#
# issue 01a156e4 (narrow undef after ref/defined/blessed guards) removed the
# entries the narrowing now sees through: a `ref($x)` truthy guard (plain,
# `&&` short-circuit, `unless ... return`, an if/elsif chain whose earlier
# branch consumes the falsy value), the same for a named array's
# literal-index element and for $_, and reftype/refaddr/sum declared as
# multis by argument type or arity. What remains is undef reaching an
# operator with no such guard in scope, each re-measured against the
# real site's own variable and operator (not a decoy construct).
#
# Math/BigInt.pm:2400 and :3380 are a known gap, left here rather than
# fixed: both are reached only after `unless $x->isa(__PACKAGE__)`
# exits, and perl's `->isa` is a method call, true for a class-name
# string as well as a blessed reference (unlike the `isa` infix
# operator), so treating it as proof $x is a Ref would be unsound.
#
# Term/Table.pm:103 (right operand), :106 and :124 are a second known
# gap: List::Util::sum's Undef comes only from a zero-argument call, so
# it is undef-free at `sum(BORDER_SIZE, $self->{+PAD}, DIV_SIZE * (@$cols
# - 1))`, always three arguments -- perl -w is silent calling it so, and
# the evidence below is sum()'s own, the call shape that is the Undef
# bit's real source. sum is not declared by arity, by argument type
# selection's own doc (Scalar/Util.tpm is; List/Util.tpm is not, and
# says why): `multi sub sum (List @list = die) Num` beside `multi sub
# sum (List @list) Undef` take a lone `List` parameter each, so
# types.Ambiguity (select.go) rejects the pair -- asSpecific holds both
# ways at every arity but 0, and nothing else distinguishes them there.
# Select has no axis for two same-shape slurpy candidates to settle a
# tie by arity alone; fixing that is outside this issue's day.
